## Scope and verification
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-19. This is a public information guide, not live inventory, a binding offer, legal advice or a private dealer agreement. Unknown specifications remain unasserted. No reviews, ratings, sales-history claims, partner approvals or shipping eligibility are inferred.

## Company and history
MT E.L.K., INC. is a hunting call manufacturer based in Livingston, Montana. The company account dates its origin to 1985; dated primary newspaper coverage is preserved from 1986. Consult the About, Legacy and Archive pages for source distinctions, people and original scans.

## Education and product care
Education, Videos, University and Banding provide on-site embedded media. Follow model-specific verified demonstrations; a band-replacement lesson is not a reed-replacement lesson. University review checkboxes are local browser progress, not accounts, exams, qualifications or certifications. Videos retain their original spoken language. Do not infer instructions from video titles.

I have bee around a lot of different elk bugling in my 40 years of filming. The MT E.L.K., INC. “Power Bugle”, without a doubt, is the most powerful, realistic elk bugle ever developed. You owe it to yourself to learn “Power Bugling”. It will become a household phrase like “Cow Talk” is in the elk hunting world. When you see the video you will understand why I am so high on “Power Bugling” elk. One of the most exciting sequences is when an old bull leaves his cows and travels 600 yards to come to the “Power Bugle”, throwing dirt clods 20 yards into the air—he came to fight. You will see several sic point bulls challenge the “Power Bugle” as close as 20 feet. This video is not only on bugling, but a source of information on why, when, where and how to become a successful elk bugler. 60 minutes.

### Royal Bugle Pro Edition
- Product ID: 751638698
- Product guide: https://www.mtelkinc.com/catalog/products/751638698/
- Live options, price and stock: https://www.mtelkinc.com/shop/#!/Royal-Bugle-Pro-Edition/p/751638698
- Categories: elk, calls
- Last checked: 2026-11-19
- SKU: 00110

The Royal Bugle Pro Edition is the same Rover Bugle that you love, with all the latest and greatest accessories we have to offer.

THE ROYAL BUGLE IS VERY UNIQUE YET EXTREMELY EASY TO USE. IT WILL PRODUCE SQUEALS, GRUNTS, SCREAMS, CHUCKLES, GROWLS AND FULL RUT BUGLES. VARYING AIR PRESSURE CREATES THE SOUNDS.

Adjustments: The mouth piece will slide in and out allowing you to adjust the opening between the housing and the band to fit your lip size. Once you find the correct opening size, check the adjustments marks or place friction cloth behind to ease resetting in the future. The call is set for approximately the correct opening.

Instructions:

Put the call in your mouth until your lips touch the back portion of the housing.

Varying air pressure with your tongue will keep the band from sticking to your lips.

Slightly slant the housing down. Your upper lip will block the upper opening.

BUGLES - Begin with your lower lip relaxed. This will give you a low grunting beginning. As you blow, tighten up your lower lip, maintaining air pressure. The more you tighten your lower lip, the higher the pitch will be. To end the bugle, quickly relax your lips, drop your bottom jaw and force what air you have left in your lungs out.

SQUEALS & CHUCKLES - Begin with your lip relaxed. Force a short burst of air out and quickly relax your lips and drop your bottom jaw. A series of chuckles can also be accomplished using this method.

SQUEALS - Begin with your lips tight. As you blow, maintain air pressure and air pressure. To end your squeal, quickly relax your lips, drop your bottom jaw and force what air you have left in your lungs out.

SCREAMS - With the call in your mouth. With your lips relaxed, blow the air over both sides of the band. Vibrate the entire sides of the band to vibrate and make a raspy, screaming sound. To end your scream, quickly force what air you have left in your lungs out while dropping your bottom jaw.

GROWLS - Start with your lips relaxed. As you blow, use your voice with a deep, low gutteral hum. Growls can be used at the beginning and ending of bugles, squeals and screams.

Features:

Quickly extends from 10" to 24" providing a variety of realistic sounds.

Elastic lanyard allows you to use the call freely while keeping it snug against your body while on stand (models with reeds from one call to another with adjustable tube)

Produce bugles and cow sounds

Replacing The Band:

Pull the mouth piece out.

Stretch the mouth piece so rotating the U-clamp.

Slide the new band over the mouth piece, placing the band in the indented area making sure the band stays flat on both sides of the mouth piece.

Rotate the U-clamp back and reinsert it into the housing to the desired position.

Replacement Bands

White Power Bands - Thickest & lowest pitch

Grey Power Bands - Medium thickness & higher pitch

The Black Bands - Thinnest & highest pitch

- https://www.mtelkinc.com/education/lessons/royal-bugle-band-replacement/

## Public questions
Where do I buy? Use the live store linked from each product guide.
How do I identify a replacement? Match the exact model and replacement lesson, or contact support.
Does submitting an application approve my account? No. The team reviews it and confirms next steps.
Are all countries in the international section served? No. Confirm current availability and terms with the team.
Are videos translated automatically? No. Original spoken language is retained.
